messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have a tool that can directly pull that data from a live source. However, I can provide you with the list of Canadian long weekends for 2023 so you can copy it into your app:

| Date | Holiday | Long Weekend |
|------|---------|--------------|
| Jan 1 – Jan 2 | New Year’s Day (Mon) | 3‑day (Mon‑Wed) |
| Feb 20 – Feb 21 | Family Day (Mon) | 3‑day (Mon‑Tue) |
| Apr 7 – Apr 8 | Good Friday (Fri) | 3‑day (Fri‑Sun) |
| May 22 – May 23 | Victoria Day (Mon) | 3‑day (Mon‑Tue) |
| Jul 1 – Jul 3 | Canada Day (Thu) | 3‑day (Thu‑Sat) |
| Sep 18 – Sep 19 | Labour Day (Mon) | 3‑day (Mon‑Tue) |
| Oct 9 – Oct 10 | Thanksgiving (Mon) | 3‑day (Mon‑Tue) |
| Nov 20 – Nov 21 | Remembrance Day (Mon) | 3‑day (Mon‑Tue) |
| Dec 24 – Dec 26 | Christmas & Boxing Day (Fri‑Sun) | 4‑day (Fri‑Mon) |

Feel free to copy the table or the dates into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the data in a different format (e.g., JSON), let me know!
